information.title: who am i?
information.paragraph_2: I'm Yushtify, also known as Bulut Bozkurt. I'm a Web Developer specializing in Frontend Development and Engineering. With over two years of experience in building responsive and modern websites using contemporary web technologies and frameworks, I've worked on a variety of projects, ranging from large-scale streaming platforms to smaller personal portfolios like this one.
information.paragraph_3: Currently, I use Astro as my primary framework alongside TypeScript to build responsive, modern, and user-friendly websites accessible to everyone.
information.paragraph_4: I plan and organize every aspect of my projects using Obsidian and Excalidraw. I use Figma for prototyping and designing my projects, and I've been working with Figma for over three years, particularly in component design, styling, and interactive prototyping.
